image_description: A white, rectangular flip-top lighter (resembling a Zippo style) standing upright against a black background. The front face features a printed graphic of a yellow cartoon character with black outlines and red text/elements. The lid is closed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Compact handheld device sized to fit comfortably within a closed palm.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object's proportions relative to its functional components (hinge, lid) are consistent with standard pocket lighters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular or cylindrical body with hinged lid or fixed top.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The object clearly exhibits a rectangular prism shape with a distinct horizontal seam indicating a hinged flip-top lid.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flame emerges from small metal tube at top when activated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lighter is not activated; no flame is visible. The chimney structure is obscured by the angle and lighting.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flint wheel or piezoelectric button ignition mechanism.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A small metallic protrusion consistent with a flint wheel assembly is visible on the upper left side near the hinge.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Fuel nozzle producing flame from internal reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The nozzle is located under the lid/chimney area which is not clearly resolved in this view, and the device is off.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Hinged flip-top lid or fixed top with spark wheel.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horizontal line separating the top third of the object confirms the presence of a flip-top lid mechanism.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Metal or plastic casing with brushed chrome or colored enamel finish.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The surface appears smooth with a slight sheen, consistent with painted metal or high-quality plastic typical of lighters.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Internal butane or lighter fluid reservoir.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Internal components are inherently occluded by the opaque casing.
The overall form factor matches the definition of a portable ignition device.

artifact_observations.location: Printed graphic on the front face
artifact_observations.reasoning: The yellow and red graphic appears slightly 'painted on' or fused with the white surface rather than sitting distinctly on top. The edges of the black outlines show minor bleeding into the white background, lacking the crispness of a real decal or laser engraving.

artifact_observations.location: Top right corner of the lid
artifact_observations.reasoning: The corner radius seems slightly inconsistent with the bottom corners, appearing somewhat softer or melted, though this could be due to lighting/reflection.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of lighter (e.g., Zippo-style vs. generic) and verify class alignment.
To check for edge bleeding between the white casing and the black background, and to verify the continuity of the lid seam.
To analyze the quality of the text/character print for signs of AI gibberish or texture smearing.

focus_areas: Sharpness of the lid seam/hinge line
Legibility and structural integrity of the printed graphic/text
Edge definition against the black background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the printed graphic. AI often fails to render coherent text or clean lines on curved surfaces. Check if the 'red text' is legible or just abstract shapes. Also, verify if the reflection on the white surface is physically consistent with a single light source.
